question:
A 35-year-old woman at 12 weeks' gestation comes for a prenatal checkup. She has discontinued
alcohol consumption since learning of her pregnancy 2 weeks ago and does not smoke. Her ultrasound
examination reveals the following findings: | **Ultrasound finding** | **Measured** | **Normal value
(age-specified)** | | --- | --- | --- | | Heart rate | 148/min | 137–150/min | | Crown-rump length | 44 mm |
45–52 mm | | Nasal bone | visualized | visualized | | Nuchal translucency | 3.3 mm | < 2.5 mm | Which of

the following is the correct clinical assessment for this patient? Answer Choices: (A) No further testing
is needed as findings are within normal limits. (B) Detailed fetal anatomical survey should be performed
now. (C) Levels of serum alpha-fetoprotein, hCG, and unconjugated estriol should be determined. (D)
First trimester combined screening should be repeated in 1 week. (E) Amniocentesis should be
performed immediately for definitive diagnosis. (F) At this gestational age, nuchal translucency has low
diagnostic value. (G) Cell-free fetal DNA testing should be performed before invasive testing. (H)
Cordocentesis is the most appropriate diagnostic test at this gestational age. (I) Repeat ultrasound in 2
weeks to confirm findings. (J) Genetic diagnosis by chorionic villus sampling should be performed.
 A. First trimester combined screening should be repeated in 1 week.
B. Detailed fetal anatomical survey should be performed now.
C. Amniocentesis should be performed immediately for definitive diagnosis.
D. Repeat ultrasound in 2 weeks to confirm findings.
E. Cordocentesis is the most appropriate diagnostic test at this gestational age.
F. Cell-free fetal DNA testing should be performed before invasive testing.
G. At this gestational age, nuchal translucency has low diagnostic value.
H. Genetic diagnosis by chorionic villus sampling should be performed.
I. Levels of serum alpha-fetoprotein, hCG, and unconjugated estriol should be determined.
J. No further testing is needed as findings are within normal limits.
